No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Fountain Of Life Church: Who Has The Authority To Remove Jimmy Odukoya? by Ngozi Ibe 12 seconds ago in Entertainment Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The leadership of The Fountain of Life Church is facing a dispute following conflicting statements over the position of its Senior Pastor, Pastor Jimmy Odukoya. A group identifying itself as the church’s Board of Trustees announced on Tuesday, 17th of November 2026, that it had withdrawn recognition of Odukoya as Senior Pastor with immediate effect, citing the church’s constitution and an alleged succession video recorded by its late founder, Pastor Taiwo Odukoya. However, a statement issued by the church’s headquarters rejected the decision, describing it as constitutionally invalid. It maintained that Jimmy remains Senior Pastor and Chairman of the Board of Trustees, following his unanimous appointment in September 2023. The disagreement centres on the authority of the trustees, the circumstances surrounding Jimmy’s appointment and the procedures for removing a church leader. In its statement, the group behind the removal announcement said it had reviewed a video allegedly recorded in December 2021, in which the late founder gave instructions concerning succession. The group claimed the recording showed that Pastor Taiwo had designated another person as his successor and had assigned Jimmy administrative and youth church responsibilities. It also alleged that the video was not produced when trustees inquired about succession arrangements after the founder’s death in August 2023. The group did not identify the alleged successor or release the recording. In its response, the church described the removal announcement as the position of individuals referring to themselves as “Concerned Members of the Board”. It said the announcement was not a valid decision of the Board of Trustees under the church’s constitution. The church also alleged that some of the trustees behind the announcement had been asked to resign on March 14, 2026, over repeated violations of the constitution and the church’s founding principles. According to the statement, the communication was delivered and acknowledged, while one trustee subsequently resigned. The church did not identify the trustees involved or release the correspondence relating to the alleged resignation requests. It maintained that Jimmy’s appointment was unanimously approved by the trustees in September 2023 and that no valid decision had been taken to remove him. The group seeking Jimmy’s removal also raised concerns about his recent remarriage, describing it as inconsistent with the church’s teachings, founding values and expectations of its spiritual leadership. Jimmy introduced his new wife, Mo Odukoya, to the congregation during a service on November 1. The church’s response did not directly address the criticism of his remarriage or the allegations concerning the succession video. Jimmy’s sister, Pastor Tolu Odukoya-Ijogun, confirmed the authenticity of the initial statement to Premium Times but declined to comment on its substance. “I have no response for now. All I can say is that it is a valid statement from the board,” she said. The church’s constitution is central to resolving the dispute. Both sides have cited it to support their positions, but the relevant provisions have not been made public in the statements issued so far. The constitution, minutes of the November 16 meeting, records of Jimmy’s September 2023 appointment, and documents relating to the alleged March 14 resignation requests are necessary to establish the groups’ authority and determine whether the required procedures were followed. The alleged December 2021 video also requires independent verification, including its authenticity, contents and whether it formed part of the church’s formal succession arrangements. The church has urged members and the public to remain calm, insisting that Jimmy remains its Senior Pastor. However, the competing statements have left questions about the church’s leadership unresolved, particularly who has the authority to appoint or remove the Senior Pastor and whether the November 16 decision complied with the church’s constitution.
